o_que_e: The site's own short vocabulary, declared because it cannot be detected. These are the fragments the builders write inside f-strings — a label on a counter, a word between two links, the head of a footer block. build/i18n.py will not take a run of under two words from a page, because one word is usually a name, and the accent test that finds the rest misses «Aviso» and «Fontes». Detecting them by shape was tried and pulled in the console's own English along with them.
como_se_estende: Add the Portuguese string. `python3 build/locales.py --relatorio` lists every run a reader would see in Portuguese that the memory cannot serve, most frequent first; that list is where these came from and is where the next ones come from. A label missing here stays Portuguese in every locale, which is the visible failure rather than the silent one.
